channel.title: Federal News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Federal News Network (federalnewsnetwork.com)

item.title: Cross-border trafficking: From detection to interdiction
item.description: How multi-sensor fusion and analysis strengthen border operations.

item.title: Treasury releases two new resources to guide AI use in the financial sector
item.description: The voluntary guidelines come as financial institutions increasingly rely on AI to support decision-making, customer engagement and operational functions.

item.title: Army tackling its ‘Achilles heel’ of IT modernization
item.description: Leo Garciga, the Army’s chief information officer, said the move toward enterprise services is changing the culture of system development to be more adaptable.

item.title: Trump’s big speech will be delivered to a changed nation and a Congress he has sidelined
item.description: As the lawmakers sit in the House chamber listening to Trump's agenda for the year ahead, the moment is an existential one for the Congress.

item.title: AI is producing exploits faster than we can patch
item.description: In operational technology environments where patching timelines are long, the speed of AI-developed exploits poses a grave risk to critical infrastructure.

item.title: Ruling on tariffs, DHS shutdown add pressure ahead of State of the Union
item.description: "This will be the only State of the Union address ever made where part of the government was actually shut down," WTOP's Mitchell Miller said.

item.title: Congress.gov conducting user research for website modernization
item.description: "User-centered design really shapes everything that the Library of Congress does in terms of creating digital solutions." Kristen Davis said.

item.title: The BIOSECURE Act is coming, and no contractor is as “biotech‑free” as they think
item.description: "[O]ur companies have until June of 2028 to get there. That should not be a sigh of relief," Alex Major said.

item.title: Education Dept moves more work to other agencies, but hasn’t yet reassigned more employees
item.description: Unlike earlier interagency agreements, the Education Department says it has not yet transferred any of its personnel to the State Department or HHS.

item.title: OPM tweaks, clarifies federal hiring rules for college students
item.description: A final rule from OPM lets agencies continue hiring certain students to temporary paid positions, but with a few changes attempting to add flexibility.
